conditional_algorithm: IF rule not original-issued OR native source/rights missing THEN NATIVE=HELD; keep all possible candidate decisions explicitly TEST_ONLY and uncommitted.
IF E1 not admitted, actor/source identity mismatched, future/revoked evidence, or forged A/B event THEN DENY (not a psychological negative).

IF objective B share/refusal or tool availability exists but actor access to THIS E1 is not established THEN A status UNKNOWN_RECEIVABILITY; response_effects VALID_EMPTY; no assertion A perceived B, A learned or A preferred an outcome.
IF A saw E1 but no A-owned immediate response is witnessed THEN status RECEIVABLE_NO_OBSERVED_UPTAKE; effect VALID_EMPTY; observation cannot decide A's private appraisal.

IF A's independently performed, time-ordered event-specific ATTEND_OBJECT, REQUEST_TOOL or EXPLICIT_REFUSAL is witnessed and actor access verified THEN candidate status OBSERVED_IMMEDIATE_OBJECT_ORIENTATION or OBSERVED_CURRENT_REFUSAL accordingly, with actor-owned source ref. Positive is observed present action, NOT inferred motive/disposition.

IF incompatible current project is witnessed AND no observed A response THEN AMBIGUOUS_CONTRADICTORY; effect VALID_EMPTY; if A response is independently witnessed preserve both contrary and response refs without synthesizing them.
NEVER infer response from task/role/class/Enneagram, B-only world event, two historical acts, a later synthetic E2, or external narrator. NEVER emit V3MS on CAN008.

conditional_algorithm: IF no actor-linked, independently supported longitudinal acquisition plus role/selection/competence alternatives => NO_CHANGE; no target proposal; C9R evaluate_target(proposal=None) returns NO_CHANGE/NO_PROPOSAL.
IF A enacted episode occurred, preserve objective action/world history through its own owner; DO NOT treat it as proof of durable V3MS.
IF multiple enacted episodes exist but independent before/after transfer and matched opportunities absent, still NO_CHANGE.
IF contradictory projects, denied opportunity, refused material offer or actor did not enact, preserve contradiction and NO_CHANGE.
IF fraudulent source/forbidden original grant => DENY not NO_CHANGE; if needed histories cannot be observed => epistemic UNKNOWN/HOLD with no target.
Any later CREATE/REVISE requires a NEW independently issued rule and grant, test negative prior-history cut at same later E2/C12 actor effect.

scientific_alternatives.H1: Acquired context-dependent inspection practice rather than ability previously present; requires independent pre/post practices under matched material opportunities across contexts, no-change countercases, transfer corroboration.
scientific_alternatives.H0: role/task selection and preexisting knowledge with identical observed inspections; default live. Sever earlier practice history while controlling baseline ability and opportunities in held-out later E2; acquisition difference must disappear.
scientific_alternatives.H2: independent B share alters feasible tools, not A's access or internal response; B refusal/share should change material capability even when both produce same outward HELP_REFUSE.
scientific_alternatives.H3: incompatible projects, latency, refusals, institutional obligations make A response varied or no-change; no priority coefficient or forced integration.
